name: HUDson
tagline: Wearables that show deaf users the direction and type of sounds around them, like a game HUD.
problem: Losing hearing removes cues about what is happening around you, as playing a game muted shows.
solution: A 3D-printed neckband senses audio direction and type; wrist modules and glasses display or vibrate the cues.
demo_moment: Team-described: a sound behind you lights the matching direction on your wrist.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Elevenlabs” among 169 submissions.
Borrows a game interface idea for real life.

lessons: Game interfaces offer ready-made accessibility metaphors.
